title: A shipped Lua rule of the kbingest pattern table is quadratic on a hostile line, and the in-process mapper has no timeout
goal: kbingest's pattern-row guard refuses a rules row whose adjacent quantifiers overlap; the shipped Lua def rule takes under 0.5 ms on a 990-letter hostile line and still names the function of function f(, function M.f( and function M:f(; PatternMapper stops reading a file after PATTERN_FILE_TIMEOUT_S seconds and notes it; PATTERN_FILE_TIMEOUT_S is 10 and PatternMapper reads it when it maps a file

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbingest as k
maps, bad = k.load_patterns()
rules = [rx for m in maps if m.language == 'lua' for role, kind, rx in m.rules if role == 'def']
assert rules and not bad, ('the shipped Lua table has no def rule', bad)
line = 'function ' + 'a' * 990
worst = 0.0
for rx in rules:
    t = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(50):
        rx.search(line)
    worst = max(worst, (time.perf_counter() - t) / 50 * 1000)
assert worst < 0.5, ('a shipped Lua def rule takes %.2f ms on one hostile line' % worst)

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbingest as k
row = {'language': 'lua', 'role': 'def', 'kind': 'function'}
for p in (r'^\s*function\s+[\w.:]*?(?P<name>\w+)\s*\(', r'^x\w+\w*(?P<name>y)', r'^x\s*\s+(?P<name>y)', r'^x[a-z]*[a-c]+(?P<name>y)'):
    rule, why = k.rule_row(dict(row, pattern=p), 1, 'sensitive')
    assert rule is None, ('a rules row whose adjacent quantifiers overlap is accepted', p)
for p in (r'^x\w+\s*(?P<name>y)', r'^x\s+\w*(?P<name>y)'):
    rule, why = k.rule_row(dict(row, pattern=p), 1, 'sensitive')
    assert rule is not None, ('a rules row whose adjacent quantifiers are disjoint is refused', p, why)
maps, bad = k.load_patterns()
assert not bad and all(not m.skipped for m in maps), ('a shipped rules row is refused by the guard', [m.skipped for m in maps if m.skipped], bad)
assert sum(len(m.rules) for m in maps) == 12, ('the shipped rules table does not load its 12 rules', sum(len(m.rules) for m in maps))

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import pathlib, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbingest as k
d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(d / 'a.lua').write_text('function one()\nend\nfunction two()\nend\nfunction three()\nend\n')
notes, syms = [], []
class Ctx:
    def readable(self, rel): return d / rel
    def note(self, t): notes.append(t)
    def add_imports(self, rel, mods): pass
    def add_entry_point(self, rel, kind): pass
    def add_symbol(self, name, kind, rel, line, uses): syms.append(name)
m = [x for x in k.PATTERN_MAPPERS if x.language == 'lua'][0]
m.map(Ctx(), ['a.lua'])
assert syms == ['one', 'two', 'three'] and not notes, ('a normal file no longer maps whole and quietly', syms, notes)
assert getattr(k, 'PATTERN_FILE_TIMEOUT_S', None) == 10, ('PATTERN_FILE_TIMEOUT_S is not 10', getattr(k, 'PATTERN_FILE_TIMEOUT_S', None))
k.PATTERN_FILE_TIMEOUT_S = 0
syms.clear(); notes.clear()
m.map(Ctx(), ['a.lua'])
assert len(syms) < 3 and any('a.lua' in n for n in notes), ('PatternMapper reads a file past PATTERN_FILE_TIMEOUT_S with no note', syms, notes)

Check 3 (the guards test selection, a critical component) passes before the work: it pins the existing guard test. The repro is index 4.
